Script.name: workaround for add
Script.script: -- Once Geyser.add2 is in this is not needed anymore -- the script runs again on every install, and wrapping an add it wrapped before would hide twice per add local add = Adjustable.Container.guiDropOriginalAdd or Adjustable.Container.add -- 1.3 and earlier wrapped it without keeping the original while debug.getupvalue(add, 1) == "addwrapper" do add = select(2, debug.getupvalue(add, 1)) end Adjustable.Container.guiDropOriginalAdd = add function Adjustable.Container:add(window, cons) add(self, window, cons) -- asked again when the timer fires, as whoever hid it may have shown it again by then if self.hidden then tempTimer(0, function() if self.hidden then self:hide() end end) end if self.auto_hidden then tempTimer(0, function() if self.auto_hidden then self:hide(true) end end) end end

Script.name: createDropManager
Script.script:
GUIDropManager = GUIDropManager or {} GUIDropImages = GUIDropImages or {} GUIDropManager.unrestored = GUIDropManager.unrestored or {} GUIDropManager.saved = GUIDropManager.saved or {}
-- each image is restored on its own, and one that cannot be (its user window is not -- open yet) is kept for the next save rather than dropped from the GUIDropManager script function GUIDropManager.restore(name, chunk) GUIDropManager.saved[name] = chunk local restoreImage, err = loadstring(chunk, "GUIDropManager: " .. name) local ok = false if restoreImage then ok, err = pcall(restoreImage) end if ok then GUIDropManager.unrestored[name] = nil else GUIDropManager.unrestored[name] = chunk debugc("gui-drop could not bring back the image " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(err)) end return ok, err end
function GUIDropManager.restoreUnrestored(report) for name, chunk in pairs(GUIDropManager.unrestored) do local ok, err = GUIDropManager.restore(name, chunk) if not ok and report then echo(string.format("
gui-drop could not bring back the image %s: %s
It stays saved for the next start; lua GUIDropManager.forget(%q) removes it.
", name, tostring(err), name)) end end end
-- for an image that cannot come back, such as one whose user window is gone for good function GUIDropManager.forget(name) GUIDropManager.unrestored[name] = nil GUIDropManager.createDropManager() end
function GUIDropManager.createDropManager() local labelscript = [[%s = %s or Geyser.Label:new({name = "%s", x="%s", y="%s", width="%s", height="%s"%s}, %s) %s:setStyleSheet("border-image: url(" .. getMudletHomeDir() .. "/GUIDropImages/" .. %q .. ");") %s.imgName = %q %s:setDropImg() ]] local containerscript = [[%s = %s or Adjustable.Container:new({name = "%s", x = "%s", y = "%s", width = "%s", height = "%s", lockStyle = "full", padding = 0, noLimit = true%s%s}%s) ]] local function imageScript(key, v) local container = "" local containervar = "" local locked = "" if v.windowname ~= "main" then container = v.containervar or GUIDropManager.getKeyFrom(v.container, ".container") if not container then -- quoted, as a window's name need not be a Lua identifier ("chat window", "end") container = string.format("Geyser.windowList[%q].windowList[%q]", v.windowname.."Container", v.windowname) end containervar = ", containervar = "..string.format("%q", container) v.containervar = container -- with no window, Adjustable.Container:new would put the image on the main window instead container = string.format(", assert(%s, %q)", container, "its user window is not open") end if v.locked then locked = ", locked = true" end local chunk = string.format(containerscript, v.name, v.name, v.name, v.x, v.y, v.width, v.height, locked, containervar, container) local label = GUIDropImages[key.."Label"] if label then local clickthrough = "" if label.clickthrough then clickthrough = ", clickthrough = true" end local parent = label.container.container.name chunk = chunk..string.format(labelscript, label.name, label.name, label.name, label.x, label.y, label.width, label.height, clickthrough, parent, label.name, label.imgName, label.name, label.imgName, parent) end assert(loadstring(chunk)) return chunk end local function longString(text) -- not level 0: Lua 5.1 refuses a [[ inside [[...]] local level = "=" while text:find("]"..level.."]", 1, true) do level = level.."=" end return "["..level.."[
"..text.."]"..level.."]" end
local entries = {} for key, v in pairs(GUIDropImages) do -- an image that did not come back whole is saved as it was, not as the part that came back if v.type == "adjustablecontainer" and not GUIDropManager.unrestored[key] then local ok, chunk = pcall(imageScript, key, v) if ok then entries[key] = chunk else entries[key] = GUIDropManager.saved[key] echo("
gui-drop could not save the image "..key..": "..tostring(chunk).."
") end end end for key, chunk in pairs(GUIDropManager.unrestored) do entries[key] = chunk end
-- the package can load after this script (it was reinstalled, or is a module), and -- brings the images back then; uninstalled, nothing does local script = {"--GUIDropManager", "local restore = GUIDropManager and GUIDropManager.restore or function(name, chunk)", " GUIDropPendingImages = GUIDropPendingImages or {}", " GUIDropPendingImages[name] = chunk", "end"} for key, chunk in pairs(entries) do script[#script + 1] = string.format("restore(%q, %s)", key, longString(chunk)) end GUIDropManager.script = table.concat(script, "
").."
" local ok, err = pcall(setScript, "GUIDropManager", GUIDropManager.script, 2) if ok then GUIDropManager.saved = entries else echo("
gui-drop could not save the GUIDropManager script: "..tostring(err).."
") end end

Script.name: Global Variable Functions
Script.script: function GUIDropManager.getKeyFrom(value, exclude, depth, table, iteration) exclude = exclude or false depth = depth or 3 table = table or _G local tempTable = {} iteration = iteration or 1 if iteration > depth then return nil, "key not found" end -- the key found is written into the GUIDropManager script, so only keys that -- make a valid Lua path are followed local keywords = {["and"] = true, ["break"] = true, ["do"] = true, ["else"] = true, ["elseif"] = true, ["end"] = true, ["false"] = true, ["for"] = true, ["function"] = true, ["if"] = true, ["in"] = true, ["local"] = true, ["nil"] = true, ["not"] = true, ["or"] = true, ["repeat"] = true, ["return"] = true, ["then"] = true, ["true"] = true, ["until"] = true, ["while"] = true} local function validName(key) return type(key) == "string" and key:match("^[%a_][%w_]*$") ~= nil and not keywords[key] end for k,v in pairs(table) do if type(k) == "string" and (iteration > 1 or validName(k)) then if type(v) == "table" and k ~= "_G" then for k1,v1 in pairs(v) do if validName(k1) then tempTable[k.."."..k1] = v1 end end end if v == value and not string.find(k, exclude, 1, true) then return k end end end return GUIDropManager.getKeyFrom(value, exclude, depth, tempTable, iteration + 1) end

Script.name: createDropScript
Script.script: function GUIDropManager.createDropScript() if exists("GUIDropManager", "script") == 0 then permGroup("GUIDropManager", "script") end if exists("GUIDropManager", "script") < 2 then permScript("GUIDropManager", "GUIDropManager","--GUIDropManager Script") enableScript("GUIDropManager") echo("DropScript created!") end GUIDropManager.createDropManager() end

Script.name: ImageDrop
Script.script:
function GUIDropManager.ImageDrop(event, fname, suffix, posx, posy, consoleName) Adjustable.Container:saveAll() local acceptable_suffix = {"png", "jpg", "bmp", "jpeg"}
if not table.contains(acceptable_suffix, suffix) then return end
local acontainer = Geyser if consoleName ~= "main" then local userWindow = Geyser.windowList[consoleName.."Container"] acontainer = userWindow and userWindow.windowList[consoleName] if not acontainer then return end end local main_width, main_height = getMainWindowSize() local image_width, image_height = getImageSize(fname)
if not image_width then return end local image_ratio = image_height / image_width if image_width > main_width-50 or image_height > main_height-50 then image_height = main_height-50 image_width = (main_height-50) / image_ratio end
posx = math.max(0, posx - (image_width/10)) posy = math.max(0, posy - (image_height/10)) -- sysDropEvent paths use "/" even on Windows, and elsewhere a backslash can be part of a file name local baseName = fname:match("([^/]+)$") local imgName = baseName:match("^(.*)%.[^.]*$") or baseName
local dropDirectory = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/GUIDropImages/" if not (io.exists(dropDirectory)) then lfs.mkdir(dropDirectory) end
--copy file to my profile location local infile, readError = io.open(fname, "rb") if not infile then error("gui-drop could not read the dropped image: " .. tostring(readError)) end local instr = infile:read("*a") infile:close() -- a different image with the same file name (from another folder) gets a copy of its own local copyName = imgName local copies = 0 while io.exists(dropDirectory .. copyName .. "." .. suffix) do local existing = io.open(dropDirectory .. copyName .. "." .. suffix, "rb") local same = existing and existing:read("*a") == instr if existing then existing:close() end if same then break end copies = copies + 1 copyName = imgName .. copies end local imgLocation = dropDirectory .. copyName .. "." .. suffix if not (io.exists(imgLocation)) then local outfile, writeError = io.open(imgLocation, "wb") if not outfile then error("gui-drop could not copy the image into " .. dropDirectory .. ": " .. tostring(writeError)) end outfile:write(instr) outfile:close() end
--convert filename to be a feasible variablename local containername = string.gsub(imgName,"[^_%w]","") --if filename is only composed of number convert it if not containername:match("%D+") then containername = "defaultName" end --a name that merely *starts* with a digit ("20260803_164803.jpg", the shape --every phone camera produces) passes the check above, but createDropManager --emits it as `GUIDropImages.<name> = ...` - which is a syntax error, so --setScript rejects the generated script and the drop is lost. Prefix it. if containername:match("^%d") then containername = "_"..containername end
--Check if image exists already and create new containername by adding +1 to the name if GUIDropImages[containername] or _G[containername] or GUIDropManager.unrestored[containername] then while GUIDropImages[containername] or _G[containername] or GUIDropManager.unrestored[containername] do counter = containername:match("%d+$") if counter ~= nil then containername = containername:sub(1,-(string.len(counter)+1)) end counter = counter or 0 counter = counter + 1 containername = containername..counter end end
containername = containername local labelname = containername.."Label"
GUIDropImages[containername] = Adjustable.Container:new({name="GUIDropImages."..containername, lockStyle = "full", padding = 0, noLimit = true, autoLoad = false, autoSave = false} , acontainer) GUIDropImages[containername]:move(posx, posy) GUIDropImages[containername]:resize(image_width, image_height) GUIDropImages[containername]:setPercent(true, true) GUIDropImages[labelname] = Geyser.Label:new({name = "GUIDropImages."..labelname, x=0, y=0, width="100%", height="100%", clickthrough = true}, GUIDropImages[containername])
GUIDropImages[labelname].imgName = copyName .. ".".. suffix GUIDropManager.createDropScript() end if GUIDropManager.dropHandler then killAnonymousEventHandler(GUIDropManager.dropHandler) end GUIDropManager.dropHandler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDropEvent", "GUIDropManager.ImageDrop")
-- a user window can be opened by a sysLoadEvent handler, so the retry waits for those to run function GUIDropManager.onLoad() tempTimer(0, function() GUIDropManager.restoreUnrestored(true) end) end if GUIDropManager.loadHandler then killAnonymousEventHandler(GUIDropManager.loadHandler) end GUIDropManager.loadHandler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysLoadEvent", "GUIDropManager.onLoad")
if GUIDropManager.uninstallHandler then killAnonymousEventHandler(GUIDropManager.uninstallHandler) end -- GUIDropManager and GUIDropImages are kept: the images already dropped and their -- menu items use them until the profile closes GUIDropManager.uninstallHandler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysUninstall", function(_, packageName) if packageName ~= "gui-drop" then return end killAnonymousEventHandler(GUIDropManager.dropHandler) killAnonymousEventHandler(GUIDropManager.loadHandler) killAnonymousEventHandler(GUIDropManager.uninstallHandler) GUIDropManager.dropHandler = nil GUIDropManager.loadHandler = nil GUIDropManager.uninstallHandler = nil end)

Script.name: AdjustableContainer Additions
Script.script:
local function deleteImage(s) GUIDropManager.unrestored[string.gsub(s.name,"GUIDropImages%.","")] = nil GUIDropImages[string.gsub(s.name,"GUIDropImages%.","")] = nil GUIDropImages[string.gsub(s.name.."Label", "GUIDropImages%.","")] = nil table.remove(Adjustable.Container.all_windows, table.index_of(Adjustable.Container.all_windows, s.name)) Adjustable.Container.all[s.name] = nil if io.exists(getMudletHomeDir().."/AdjustableContainer/"..s.name..".lua") then os.remove(getMudletHomeDir().."/AdjustableContainer/"..s.name..".lua") end s:hide() end
local function convertToLabel(s) local labelscript = [[%s = %s or Geyser.Label:new({name = "%s", x="%s", y="%s", width="%s", height="%s"}%s) %s:setStyleSheet("border-image: url(" .. getMudletHomeDir() .. "/GUIDropImages/" .. %q .. ");") ]] local container = GUIDropImages[string.gsub(s.name,"GUIDropImages%.","")] local labelname = string.gsub(s.name.."Label", "GUIDropImages%.","") GUIDropImages[labelname]:changeContainer(container.container) GUIDropImages[labelname]:move(container.x, container.y) GUIDropImages[labelname]:resize(container.width, container.height)
if exists("GUIDropManager", "script") == 0 then permGroup("GUIDropManager", "script") end
if exists("GUIDropLabels", "script") == 0 then permScript("GUIDropLabels", "GUIDropManager","--GUIDropLabels Script") enableScript("GUIDropLabels") echo("LabelScript created!") end
if container.containervar then container.containervar = ","..container.containervar else container.containervar = "" end
local label = GUIDropImages[string.gsub(s.name.."Label", "GUIDropImages%.","")] labelname = labelname:sub(1,-6) labelscript = string.format(labelscript, labelname, labelname, labelname, label.x, label.y, label.width, label.height, container.containervar, labelname, label.imgName)
appendScript("GUIDropLabels", labelscript)
GUIDropImages[string.gsub(s.name,"GUIDropImages%.","")]:hide() GUIDropManager.unrestored[string.gsub(s.name,"GUIDropImages%.","")] = nil GUIDropImages[string.gsub(s.name,"GUIDropImages%.","")] = nil GUIDropImages[string.gsub(s.name.."Label", "GUIDropImages%.","")] = nil table.remove(Adjustable.Container.all_windows, table.index_of(Adjustable.Container.all_windows, s.name)) Adjustable.Container.all[s.name] = nil if io.exists(getMudletHomeDir().."/AdjustableContainer/"..s.name..".lua") then os.remove(getMudletHomeDir().."/AdjustableContainer/"..s.name..".lua") end end
function Adjustable.Container:setDropImg() if self.dropImg then return end
self.dropImg = true self.adjLabelstyle =[[ QLabel::hover{ background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0%); border: 1px solid grey;} QLabel::!hover{ background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0%);}]] if not self.locked then self.adjLabel:setStyleSheet(self.adjLabelstyle) else self.adjLabel:setStyleSheet([[border:0;]]) end self:setTitle(" ") self.minimizeLabel:raise() self.exitLabel:raise()
self:newCustomItem("setAbsolute", function(s) s:setAbsolute(true, true) self:save() end) self:newCustomItem("setPercent", function(s) s:setPercent(true, true) self:save() end) self:newCustomItem("deleteImage", function(s) deleteImage(s) GUIDropManager.createDropManager() Adjustable.Container:saveAll() end) self:newCustomItem("convertToLabel", function(s) convertToLabel(s) GUIDropManager.createDropManager() Adjustable.Container:saveAll() end) self:newCustomItem("saveAll", function(s) Adjustable.Container:saveAll() end) self:newCustomItem("loadAll", function(s) Adjustable.Container:loadAll() end) self:newCustomItem("updateScript", function(s) Adjustable.Container:saveAll() GUIDropManager.createDropManager() end) end
-- left by a GUIDropManager script that ran before the package for name, chunk in pairs(GUIDropPendingImages or {}) do GUIDropManager.unrestored[name] = chunk end GUIDropPendingImages = nil GUIDropManager.restoreUnrestored()
